name: Mabel, Bitter Recluse
description: An Echoverse mouse warlock with the staff Cragbane who drains Calamity Beasts of power to avenge her destroyed village on King Glarb.

timeline.summary: Mabel's village is destroyed and her family separated, and she vows vengeance on Glarb.
timeline.quote: When her village was destroyed and her family separated, Mabel knew Glarb was to blame.

relations.quote: Mabel knew Glarb was to blame.
